Inspection / Maintenance Item: Are all flanges and fittings properly sized for the pressure rating equal to or greater than the maximum allowable working pressure of the system?
Are all stainless steel flex connectors in good working condition (i.e., reinforcement braid is not damaged)?
Are all flow indicators and sight checks in proper working condition and leak free?
Are hydrostatic relief valves installed in the appropriate location and in good working condition?
Are all fittings and pipes leak-free?
Are ESVs in good working condition and leak-free?
Are ESVs and/or back checks (including thermal release) on riser ends of the liquid hoses in good working condition?
Are ESVS on riser ends of the vapor hose (including thermal release) in good working condition?
Has an annual test been performed and documented as required by NFPA 58?
Is the pneumatic control system in good working condition and free of leaks?
Are remote emergency shutoff devices between 25 and 100 feet from the ESV and within the path of egress?
